en: A single movable pulley reduces the effort needed to lift a 100-kilogram load to just 50 kilograms by distributing the weight across two rope segments.
A hovercraft reduces surface friction by floating on a cushion of air, allowing it to travel over land and water at speeds up to 110 kilometers per hour.
The Moon's gravity is one-sixth of Earth's, so a person with a mass of 60 kilograms experiences a gravitational pull equivalent to just 10 kilograms on the Moon.
The strongest permanent magnets, called neodymium magnets, can lift objects weighing up to 1,000 times their own mass due to their incredibly powerful magnetic fields.
A single lightning bolt can heat surrounding air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, which is five times hotter than the visible surface of the Sun.
Light travels at 300,000 kilometers per second in a vacuum, taking exactly 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth from the Sun.
Sound travels through water at 1,500 meters per second, which is more than four times faster than its 343 meters-per-second speed in air.
It takes about nine times more heat energy to raise the temperature of a liter of water compared to the exact same mass of solid iron.
When a car's speed doubles from 40 to 80 kilometers per hour, its kinetic energy increases by four times, requiring much more distance to brake.
The screw threads on a jar lid act as an inclined plane wrapped around a cylinder, multiplying your twisting force by up to 10 times.
Static friction is stronger than kinetic friction, meaning it takes significantly more force to start pushing a 50-kilogram box than to keep it sliding.
One gram of fat contains about 9 kilocalories of chemical energy, which is more than double the 4 kilocalories found in one gram of carbohydrates.
